title: Closure of Statement Support Under Substatements
statement: Let $c$ be a partial-recursive program and let $q$ and $tail$ be compiled stack-machine statements. If the optional statement $some\ q$ belongs to the finite statement support of the compilation of $c$, and $tail$ is an immediate substatement of $q$, then the optional statement $some\ tail$ also belongs to that support.
hypotheses_covered: Membership of $some\ q$ in the finite statement support
Membership of $tail$ among the immediate substatements of $q$
replaced:
The finite statement support of a compiled program is closed under immediate
substatements: if a statement belongs to the support and another statement occurs as
an immediate constituent of it, the latter also belongs to the support.
